|---|---|

| Check loyalty balance | ❌ No access to account/loyalty systems |
| See active promotions | ❌ No access to promotions data |
| Validate a promo code | ❌ No access to promo code systems |

| Escalate/transfer | ❌ No agent routing or handoff capability |
